panels.title: Collect-News: sources + rules
panels.body:
**Finnhub company-news** (top row): headlines per ticker for the 3 days ending as_of, 1.1 s between calls (60/min free tier). No sentiment on free; rows land with sentiment NULL. id = fh-<ticker>-<finnhub id>, ticker = the queried symbol, so a shared article is kept once per ticker.
**Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT** (bottom row): 25 calls/day and a multi-ticker query means ALL tickers (AND), so: 4 topic calls (technology, manufacturing, energy_transportation, financial_markets) + one call per holding + a rotating slice of the rest, 22 calls total. Per-ticker sentiment in [-1, 1]; relevance < 0.1 is dropped. id = av-<ticker>-<hash(url)>. A throttle note is logged as quota_skip, never a crash.
**Aggregate**: after both branches, one SQL rolls the last 7 days of intel.news_articles into intel.sentiment_daily (mean sentiment, article count). Benchmarks (ETFs) never get news.

zones.title: Input
zones.body: Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], benchmarks[]}. ETFs are skipped.

zones.title: Fan out
zones.body: Top: one item per ticker. Bottom: Alpha Vantage plan, 4 topic calls + holdings + a rotating slice.

zones.title: Fetch
zones.body: Rate-limited HTTP calls. neverError on: a bad reply becomes data, not a crash. Finnhub returns the full response so the status code reaches the ledger.

zones.title: Normalize
zones.body: Rows for intel.news_articles with stable ids so re-runs never duplicate.

zones.title: Store
zones.body: Upserts plus one intel.api_usage row per call: ticker or topic, ok / quota_skip / error, http code.

zones.title: Aggregate
zones.body: Merge waits for both branches, then 7-day sentiment per ticker goes to intel.sentiment_daily and counts return to the caller.
